## Overview
Nanded City is a 700-acre integrated, self-sustainable township located on Sinhagad Road, Pune - 411041, Maharashtra, India. Developed by Nanded City Development & Construction Company Limited (NCDCCL) led by Satish Magar, the township houses over 15,000 families across 20 distinct residential clusters and branded NA bungalow plots. PropSmart Realty (Authorised Marketing Partner: MahaRERA A031262401295) facilitates verified property advisory, floor plans, and site visits.

## Core Infrastructure & Civic Pillars
- **Water Security**: Captive Water Treatment Plant (WTP) with direct Khadakwasla canal raw water allocation, multi-stage sand filtration, and 24x7 pressurized potable water (zero water tankers required).
- **Wastewater & Ecology**: Captive Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) operating on MBBR/SBR technology with 100% wastewater recycling, zero-liquid-discharge (ZLD), dual-flush plumbing, and automated garden irrigation.
- **Power & Energy**: Dedicated 22kV / 11kV MSEB electrical substations with 100% underground cabling, dual feeders, and zero domestic load shedding.
- **Roads & Mobility**: 15m to 24m wide asphalt sector roads, 40m central spine road, paved pedestrian tracks, and dedicated cycling paths.
- **Security & Safety**: 3-tier centralized security system with 300+ night-vision CCTV cameras, RFID automated boom barriers, and gated cluster checkpoints.
- **In-Campus Education**: Vidya Pratishthan's Nanded City Public School (ICSE) and Pawar Public School (ICSE/CBSE) within walking distance.
- **Sports & Recreation**: Kridaangan Sports Complex and Club Harmony featuring Olympic-dimension 50m swimming pool, floodlit tennis courts, indoor badminton, skating rink, and gym.
- **Commercial & Retail**: Destination Center-I and Destination Center-II featuring supermarkets (Reliance Smart), national banks & ATMs (SBI, HDFC, ICICI), clinics, restaurants, and Symphony IT Park.
